'''Prax Arms''' was a underground weapons manufacturing company that found its niche in [[Slugthrower/Legends|slugthrower]] and [[dart shooter]] weapons production.<ref name="NEGWT" /> Prax was the manufacturer of the popular [[PRP-502 hold-out dart shooter|Protector PRP-502 dart pistol]] and the [[Model AXM-50 "Blast and Smash"]].<ref name="GG10" />
